methods.what: Solution of $v''+\lambda v=P$ by variation of constants (Duhamel integral)
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}+\lambda v=P\qquad v=\frac{1}{\sqrt{\lambda}}\int_0^y P\sin\sqrt{\lambda}(y-z)\,\partial z+a\cos\sqrt{\lambda}\,y$

methods.what: Integrating a PDE against $\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,x$ over $[-a,a]$ (finite cosine transform with integration by parts) to get an ODE in $y$ with boundary terms
Combining the forcing terms $P_1,P_2$ to eliminate terms, then integrating to express boundary values of $u$ and $\partial u/\partial x$
